resources.string: Cycles through the spectrum very slowly so it won\'t make you dizzy.
I don\'t have my model downloaded yet. Go to Settings › AI and tap “Download model” (one time, on Wi‑Fi).
To chat, first accept the AI terms.

The chat uses Qwen2.5‑1.5B‑Instruct, a language model from Alibaba Cloud (Qwen team), in a version converted by litert-community to run on Android with MediaPipe. It is downloaded once from Hugging Face (about 1.6 GB).
In local mode the model runs on your phone without internet: your messages never leave the device. Only the model download uses internet. MusicFlame does not receive your conversations.

It is a small model and can be wrong or make things up (years, BPM, albums, lyrics). Double-check important information. Don\'t use it for medical, legal, financial or safety decisions. Provided “as is”, without warranties.
It uses about 1.6 GB of storage and around 2 GB of RAM while answering. It can take several seconds, warm up the phone and use battery. You can delete the model anytime in Settings › AI.

Qwen2.5‑1.5B‑Instruct and MediaPipe are distributed under the Apache 2.0 license, which allows use and redistribution with a license notice (see Settings › Third-party licenses). MusicFlame is an independent project: it is not affiliated with or endorsed by Alibaba Cloud or Google.
Local model, Apache 2.0 license. One-time download of %1$s; works offline.
Downloading on Wi‑Fi is recommended. If it is interrupted, it resumes where it left off.
Model ready (%1$s MB on your phone)
This frees the space. You can download it again anytime.
